title: Bukit Belakang Taman
subject: a condominium named Bukit Permai after the hill it flattened behind the housing estate
caption: Nusantaracore, Malay heritage post-hardcore. Drop-tuned guitars playing dissonant chord stabs and tremolo lines, with a half-time breakdown before the last chorus, hardcore drums with double-kick runs and heavy floor-tom patterns, a distorted bass locked to the kick, a serunai double-reed playing a modal Malay melody over the guitars, and gendang hand drums doubling the floor toms in the intro and the breakdown. Heavy and dense, the guitars a wide wall, the serunai cutting through the middle, the clean chorus vocal forward. Male vocals, shouted rhythmic verses with clear diction delivered like recited Malay poetry, switching to a clean melodic tenor in the chorus, with screaming kept to the breakdown. 160 BPM, C# minor. Furious, grieving a hill. No autotune, no trap beats, no pop-punk bounce, no black-metal blast beats, no synths.
lyrics:
[Intro - gendang and serunai, then the guitars crash in]

[Verse 1 - Shouted]
Pukul tujuh pagi, jentolak dah menderum
Bukit tempat aku tangkap labah-labah masa darjah tiga
Pokok petai, pokok kerdas, sarang tebuan yang Pak Din pernah tunjuk
Satu-satu rebah, bunyi dia macam tulang patah

[Pre-Chorus - Shouted]
Papan iklan dah naik: "Hidup Hijau, Tiga Bilik"
Hijau mana? Hijau mana?

[Chorus - Clean]
Bukit belakang taman, aku tak sempat ucap selamat tinggal
Tanah merah turun ke longkang, sampai ke pintu pagar kami
Malam ni tak ada cengkerik, tak ada bunyi apa-apa
Cuma lampu kren berkelip atas tempat kami main

[Verse 2 - Shouted]
Monyet turun cari makan, selongkar tong sampah depan surau
Orang taman marah monyet, tak ada siapa marah jentolak
Aku simpan satu batu dari puncak dalam poket seluar
Batu ni lagi tua dari kita semua, sekarang dia pun tak ada rumah

[Bridge - half-time breakdown, screamed]
Ratakan! Ratakan! Ratakan semua!
Lepas tu jual balik pada kami, letak nama "Bukit"

[Chorus - Clean]
Bukit belakang taman, aku tak sempat ucap selamat tinggal
Tanah merah turun ke longkang, sampai ke pintu pagar kami
Malam ni tak ada cengkerik, tak ada bunyi apa-apa
Cuma papan tanda menyala: Residensi Bukit Permai

[Outro - serunai alone over guitar feedback]
Bukit tu dah tak ada
Nama dia masih ada
